localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 25-30 high-contrast white circular and annular pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the dark grey/black dorsal surface of both lobes, with a high density of clusters on the left lobe between the mid-point and distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring consistent with barnacle colonization; visible white calcified material or dense scarring at the distal terminal point of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent leading-edge tubercles (nodular protuberances) visible on the left lobe, creating a distinct undulating geometric profile.
